name: Spiral Blue
source:
Inga, a lonely office worker, spends most of her monotonous days entirely in her own head. Her quiet life gets shaken up when her coworker Marine jumps off the roof of their office building, and even more so when a voice from beyond starts sending her emails. Can life be worth living because of a ghost? Should it be?

[From [url=https://dollhousing.itch.io/spiral-blue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
孤独的上班族茵嘉日复一日过着单调乏味的生活，绝大部分时间都沉浸在自己的精神世界里。然而同事玛琳从办公楼天台纵身一跃，打破了她平静的日子；更令人震惊的是，一个来自彼岸的声音开始给她发来电子邮件。一个人的人生，能够因为一只鬼魂而变得值得一活吗？又是否应该如此呢？

[摘自[url=https://dollhousing.itch.io/spiral-blue]itch.io[/url]]
